## Change type

- [ ] Tool contract / behavior
- [ ] Authentication / authorization boundary
- [ ] Gitea API compatibility

## Design goal

What this change achieves and why.

## Acceptance criteria

- Observable behavior that defines success.

## Change narrative

Describe the code, schema, information flow, and targeted Gitea release.

## Risk assessment
